array.string: SELECT 'room', lastLogId, 0, 0, 0, '', '' FROM NTChatRoom WHERE chatId=375704568186036 UNION ALL SELECT 'msg', m.logId, m.prevId, m.sentAt, m.type, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.nickName,''), u.friendNickName, ''), m.message FROM NTChatMessage m LEFT JOIN NTUser u ON u.userId=m.authorId AND u.linkId=0 WHERE m.chatId=375704568186036 AND m.sentAt >= CAST(strftime('%s','now','-100 days') AS INTEGER)
